WITH monthly_revenue AS (
    SELECT 
        DATE_TRUNC('month', created_at) AS month,
        SUM(CASE WHEN status <> 'Cancelled' THEN sale_price ELSE 0 END) AS gross_revenue
    FROM public.order_items
    WHERE created_at >= '2024-01-01' AND created_at < '2025-01-01'
    GROUP BY 1
),
mom_change AS (
    SELECT 
        month,
        gross_revenue,
        gross_revenue - LAG(gross_revenue) OVER (ORDER BY month) AS mom_increase
    FROM monthly_revenue
)
SELECT 
    TO_CHAR(month, 'YYYY-MM') AS month,
    ROUND(mom_increase::numeric, 2) AS mom_increase
FROM mom_change
ORDER BY mom_increase DESC NULLS LAST
LIMIT 1

WITH jan_users AS (
    SELECT id, created_at
    FROM public.users
    WHERE created_at >= '2024-01-01' AND created_at < '2024-02-01'
),
user_orders AS (
    SELECT u.id AS user_id,
           COUNT(DISTINCT oi.order_id) AS non_cancelled_orders
    FROM jan_users u
    LEFT JOIN public.order_items oi ON oi.user_id = u.id
        AND oi.status <> 'Cancelled'
        AND oi.created_at >= u.created_at
        AND oi.created_at < u.created_at + INTERVAL '90 days'
    GROUP BY u.id
)
SELECT 
    ROUND((COUNT(*) FILTER (WHERE non_cancelled_orders >= 2)::double precision / NULLIF(COUNT(*), 0))::numeric, 4) AS share
FROM user_orders

LEFT JOIN public.order_items oi ON oi.user_id = u.id

SELECT 
    DATE_TRUNC('month', u.created_at) AS cohort_month,
    COUNT(DISTINCT u.id) AS new_users,
    ROUND(SUM(CASE WHEN oi.status NOT IN ('Cancelled', 'Returned') THEN oi.sale_price ELSE 0 END)::numeric, 2) AS net_revenue
FROM public.users u
LEFT JOIN public.order_items oi ON oi.user_id = u.id 
    AND oi.created_at >= '2024-01-01' AND oi.created_at < '2025-01-01'
WHERE u.created_at >= '2024-01-01' AND u.created_at < '2025-01-01'
GROUP BY 1
ORDER BY 1

WITH fb_users AS (
    SELECT id FROM public.users WHERE traffic_source = 'Facebook' AND created_at >= '2024-01-01' AND created_at < '2025-01-01'
),
order_dates AS (
    SELECT oi.user_id, oi.order_id, MIN(oi.created_at) AS order_created_at
    FROM public.order_items oi
    WHERE oi.status <> 'Cancelled'
    GROUP BY oi.user_id, oi.order_id
),
ranked_orders AS (
    SELECT user_id, order_created_at,
           ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY user_id ORDER BY order_created_at) AS rn
    FROM order_dates
    WHERE user_id IN (SELECT id FROM fb_users)
),
first_second AS (
    SELECT user_id,
           MAX(CASE WHEN rn = 1 THEN order_created_at END) AS first_order,
           MAX(CASE WHEN rn = 2 THEN order_created_at END) AS second_order
    FROM ranked_orders
    GROUP BY user_id
    HAVING COUNT(*) >= 2
)
SELECT ROUND(PERCENTILE_CONT(0.5) WITHIN GROUP (ORDER BY EXTRACT(EPOCH FROM (second_order - first_order))/86400.0)::numeric, 2) AS median_days
FROM first_second

WITH new_users_2024 AS (
    SELECT id, created_at, DATE_TRUNC('month', created_at) AS acq_month
    FROM public.users
    WHERE created_at >= '2024-01-01' AND created_at < '2025-01-01'
),
users_with_early_order AS (
    SELECT DISTINCT u.id
    FROM new_users_2024 u
    WHERE EXISTS (
        SELECT 1 FROM public.order_items oi
        WHERE oi.user_id = u.id
        AND oi.status <> 'Cancelled'
        AND oi.created_at >= u.created_at
        AND oi.created_at < u.created_at + interval '30 days'
    )
)
SELECT 
    TO_CHAR(DATE_TRUNC('month', u.created_at), 'YYYY-MM') AS acq_month,
    COUNT(*) AS total_users,
    COUNT(uwo.id) AS converted_users,
    ROUND((COUNT(uwo.id)::double precision / COUNT(*))::numeric, 4) AS conversion_share
FROM new_users_2024 u
LEFT JOIN users_with_early_order uwo ON uwo.id = u.id
GROUP BY DATE_TRUNC('month', u.created_at)
ORDER BY conversion_share DESC
LIMIT 1

WITH facebook_users_2024 AS (
    SELECT id FROM public.users 
    WHERE traffic_source = 'Facebook' 
      AND created_at >= '2024-01-01' AND created_at < '2025-01-01'
),
user_orders AS (
    SELECT 
        oi.user_id,
        oi.order_id,
        MIN(oi.created_at) AS order_date,
        ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY oi.user_id ORDER BY MIN(oi.created_at)) AS order_num
    FROM public.order_items oi
    WHERE oi.status <> 'Cancelled'
      AND oi.user_id IN (SELECT id FROM facebook_users_2024)
    GROUP BY oi.user_id, oi.order_id
),
order_pairs AS (
    SELECT 
        EXTRACT(EPOCH FROM (o3.order_date - o2.order_date))/86400 AS days_between
    FROM user_orders o2
    JOIN user_orders o3 ON o2.user_id = o3.user_id AND o3.order_num = 3
    WHERE o2.order_num = 2
)
SELECT ROUND(PERCENTILE_CONT(0.5) WITHIN GROUP (ORDER BY days_between)::numeric, 0) AS median_days
FROM order_pairs

  SELECT user_id, SUM(CASE WHEN status <> 'Cancelled' THEN sale_price ELSE 0 END) AS gross_spend
  FROM public.order_items
  WHERE created_at >= '2024-01-01' AND created_at < '2025-01-01'
  GROUP BY user_id
)
SELECT ROUND(PERCENTILE_CONT(0.9) WITHIN GROUP (ORDER BY gross_spend)::numeric, 2) AS p90_gross_spend
FROM user_spend

WITH organic_users AS (
    SELECT id
    FROM public.users
    WHERE traffic_source = 'Organic'
    AND created_at >= '2024-01-01' AND created_at < '2025-01-01'
),
user_orders AS (
    SELECT 
        oi.user_id,
        oi.order_id,
        MIN(oi.created_at) AS order_created_at,
        ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY oi.user_id ORDER BY MIN(oi.created_at)) AS order_num
    FROM public.order_items oi
    WHERE oi.status <> 'Cancelled'
    AND oi.user_id IN (SELECT id FROM organic_users)
    GROUP BY oi.user_id, oi.order_id
),
first_second AS (
    SELECT 
        a.user_id,
        a.order_created_at AS first_order,
        b.order_created_at AS second_order,
        EXTRACT(EPOCH FROM (b.order_created_at - a.order_created_at)) / 86400.0 AS days_between
    FROM user_orders a
    JOIN user_orders b ON a.user_id = b.user_id AND b.order_num = 2
    WHERE a.order_num = 1
)
SELECT 
    ROUND(PERCENTILE_CONT(0.5) WITHIN GROUP (ORDER BY days_between)::numeric, 2) AS median_days
FROM first_second

WITH non_cancelled_items AS (
    SELECT order_id, user_id, sale_price, created_at
    FROM public.order_items
    WHERE status <> 'Cancelled'
      AND created_at >= '2024-01-01'
      AND created_at < '2025-01-01'
),
order_values AS (
    SELECT order_id, user_id, 
           SUM(sale_price) AS order_value,
           MIN(created_at) AS order_created_at
    FROM non_cancelled_items
    GROUP BY order_id, user_id
),
ranked_orders AS (
    SELECT order_id, user_id, order_value,
           ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY user_id ORDER BY order_created_at, order_id) AS rn
    FROM order_values
),
classified AS (
    SELECT order_value,
           CASE WHEN rn = 1 THEN 'first' ELSE 'repeat' END AS order_type
    FROM ranked_orders
)
SELECT 
    PERCENTILE_CONT(0.5) WITHIN GROUP (ORDER BY order_value) FILTER (WHERE order_type = 'first') AS first_median,
    PERCENTILE_CONT(0.5) WITHIN GROUP (ORDER BY order_value) FILTER (WHERE order_type = 'repeat') AS repeat_median,
    PERCENTILE_CONT(0.5) WITHIN GROUP (ORDER BY order_value) FILTER (WHERE order_type = 'first') 
    - PERCENTILE_CONT(0.5) WITHIN GROUP (ORDER BY order_value) FILTER (WHERE order_type = 'repeat') AS difference
FROM classified

WITH non_cancelled_orders AS (
    SELECT user_id, order_id, MIN(created_at)::date AS order_date
    FROM public.order_items
    WHERE status <> 'Cancelled'
      AND created_at >= '2024-01-01'
      AND created_at < '2025-01-01'
    GROUP BY user_id, order_id
),
ranked AS (
    SELECT user_id, order_date,
           ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY user_id ORDER BY order_date) AS rn
    FROM non_cancelled_orders
),
user_orders AS (
    SELECT user_id,
           MAX(CASE WHEN rn = 1 THEN order_date END) AS first_date,
           MAX(CASE WHEN rn = 2 THEN order_date END) AS second_date
    FROM ranked
    WHERE rn <= 2
    GROUP BY user_id
    HAVING COUNT(*) = 2
)
SELECT ROUND(PERCENTILE_CONT(0.95) WITHIN GROUP (ORDER BY (second_date - first_date))::numeric, 1) AS p95_days
FROM user_orders
